annotations.text:
Sticker pop, four gestures.
Start → Instructions → Live is the whole flow; phone views and the system sheet below.

Camera feed and the cat are placeholders — the real GIFs drop into the same slot.

Phone instructions — sized to the browser, not the device.

390x680, not 390x844: on a 844pt phone the address bar and safe areas take roughly that much, and at full device height the layout left a dead band above the button. Content now fills the frame.

Rounded 30px so it reads as a screen rather than a slab.

Also: rows carry no shadow, and the MOVE pill is a single arrow — the word never fit without wrapping the gesture name.

Phone live — the meme slot is stacked now, 300x300 above its label, full card width.

Side-by-side capped the cat at about 150px, which was smaller than it needs to be on the one screen where the cat is the point.

The tracking readout stays desktop-only. Nobody tunes thresholds on a phone.

Build note: use 100dvh, not 100vh — mobile browser chrome collapses on scroll and 100vh cuts the gesture strip off.

Fixed 400x400 slot, object-fit: contain.

The old CSS was max-width: min(44vw, 520px), so every GIF rendered at its own natural size — nerd_cat at 127px next to scuba_cat at 498px. The box is constant now and the image letterboxes inside it.

67_cat is 1.37 landscape, so it leaves ~54px of yellow top and bottom. That reads as a frame rather than dead space.

nerd_cat upscales 3.1x and will be visibly soft. The real fix is a bigger source file.
